document_path.description: JSON or JSON Lines file relative to the workspace root, for example out/result.json.

document.description: The JSON value to check, given inline. Give document or document_path, not both.

schema_path.description: JSON Schema file relative to the workspace root, for example contracts/output.schema.json.

schema.description: The JSON Schema, given inline. Give schema or schema_path, not both.

jsonl.description: true checks every nonempty line of document_path as its own JSON document.

check_formats.description: true checks format for date, date-time, time, email, uuid, ipv4 and uri.

allow_unchecked.description: true checks the supported keywords and lists the others in unchecked instead of refusing.

max_violations.description: List at most this many violations; violation_count still counts all of them.
